apps.localizedDescription:
Watch anime and YouTube. Read manga and novels. Look up words and save useful sentences without leaving the story.

One app, from immersion to review:

• Watch, read, and listen. Local videos, YouTube, manga, EPUBs, web novels, and podcasts in one app.
• Understand in context. Look up words with your imported dictionaries, use on-device manga OCR, and work with interactive subtitles.
• Keep what matters. Save sentences with audio and images where available. Review in Manatan SRS with account sync, or keep using Anki.

Your first lookup:

• Install and open Manatan. A dictionary is installed automatically.
• Open a video with subtitles, a manga chapter, or an EPUB you want to understand.
• Look up a word. Save a useful sentence to Manatan SRS or Anki, then keep going.

versions.localizedDescription:
Release v6.3.11:

• Fix Android native path conversion (892212c).
• Fix novel storage key parameter types (9d7ccc1).
• Add word tracking to the browser dictionary (5bc5f4e).
• Recover Google Drive sync from legacy checkpoints (6fe5245).
• Restore dictionary popup word status and card opening (f1d17e5).
• Guide browser extension users through setup (5483cc1).
• Keep manga images loading across rotating CDN hosts (196d78f).
• Update Flashcards extensions automatically with rollback (078ec8d).
• Add search for installed dictionaries (0035faf).
• Fix browser flashcard rendering, media sync, and lookup feedback (7089887).
• Match explicit subtitle episode numbers that resemble resolutions (32c336a).
• Show compact dashboard extensions on the mobile home screen (b2c5da8).
• Drain APK size listings without broken pipe failures (2d056b9).
• Freeze browser recovery source before applying CI overlays (cbf9610).
• Include shared vocabulary catalog in Firefox reviewer sources (c99a938).
• Keep EPUB title images on their own reader pages (2a7c3cc).

Downloads:

• The manatan-app and manatan-launcher archives are updater payloads, not the normal manual install path.
• The legacy Manatan archives are one-time migration assets for older clients.
• Android requires Android 8.0 or newer. Choose ARM64 for a 64-bit Android system, or ARM32 for a 32-bit Android system.
• ARM32 support is experimental.

• Firefox store updates require Mozilla validation/review. The Firefox ZIP is an unsigned submission package, not an installable signed XPI; use the AMO listing.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Manatan uses the camera to recognize text in photos you take and for websites you allow in the browser.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Manatan uses Face ID to unlock the app when you enable Require unlock.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Manatan uses your local network to connect to Audiobookshelf servers you add and stream their audio.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Manatan uses the microphone for websites you allow in the browser.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Manatan needs permission to save images to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Manatan uses your photo library to select images for text recognition and to save images you choose.
